# blockchainlab-compose

> Idea-to-repo engine behind blockchainlab.com/forge: turns a plain-language token/NFT idea into a tested Foundry project (components from blockchainlab-index, pragma/licence checks, generated glue, tests, deploy script, CI) and optionally creates it under github.com/Blockchains.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [blcompose/compose.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose/blob/main/blcompose/compose.py): engine
- [blcompose/recipes.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose/blob/main/blcompose/recipes.py): recipes

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-index](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-index): component source (catalog, components, taxonomy)
- [Blockchains/forge-dao-governance-token](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-dao-governance-token): reference output, re-composed in CI
- [Blockchains/forge-usd-priced-membership-nft](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-usd-priced-membership-nft): reference output, re-composed in CI
- [Blockchains/grokhack-forge](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-forge): sister composer for Grok apps
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk): add a data layer to a generated dApp
